verdict.rationale: Gusto provides API endpoints to pull payroll data (GET /v1/companies/{id}/payrolls, payroll.paid webhooks) and even a remote MCP server letting AI agents access account data via natural language, plus mentions accounting-app integrations and 'generate payroll reports' capability, which together support an agent pulling payroll data programmatically. However there's no documented journal-entry-specific export format, GL-code mapping, or explicit reconciliation workflow into a ledger. Missing for 10: explicit payroll journal/GL export schema, documented reconciliation-to-ledger workflow, and independent evidence of an agent actually performing this reconciliation end-to-end.
